name: workbench
description: Skills for the legacy Fused workbench SDK CLI (`fused workbench …`): canvas.toml format, JSON UI widget schemas, HTML template nodes (window.fused), UDFs, H3 ingestion (fused.h3), team-built beta UDFs (fused.beta), runtime packages, integrations, the workbench CLI, the reference canvases beside a fused-render canvas clone, and finding and reading S3 files from a fused-render session.

interface.shortDescription: Canvases, UDFs, and widgets for the Fused workbench SDK
